title: Annotation Record
description: Defines a single annotated content item belonging to an annotation-framework task. A task (annotation-task.schema.json) tracks who did the work and its overall status/quality; a record is the actual annotated content itself - one corrected sentence, one translation pair, one labeled span, etc.

task_id.description: Cross-reference to the owning annotation-task entry.

source_ref.description: Reference to the original content being annotated, e.g. a file path, dataset_id, or recording_id.

annotation_type.description: Must match the parent task's annotation_type.

content.description: The actual annotated content. Shape depends on annotation_type - e.g. { text, corrected_text } for transcription review, { source_text, target_text, target_language } for translation, { text, entities: [...] } for NER. Intentionally loosely typed here since content shape varies; specific shapes should be documented in this framework's README as they are first used.

annotator_id.description: Pseudonymous or role-based identifier of who produced this record, e.g. 'founder-review' or an annotator ID. Never a real name, consistent with speaker-registry's privacy-by-architecture pattern.

confidence.description: Annotator's or model's self-reported confidence in this record, if applicable.
